content:
Today from 10am-3pm, the national marrow donor program will be at the UC looking for people to add to the database. They can answer any questions you may have, and being added only takes a cheek swab.
The process of being a donor if you’re a match isn’t much more invasive than donating blood, and in the most severe cases, is a fairly noninvasive surgery. (Basically, you wake up with your hips feeling like you’ve done a leg workout, and should be back to normal within a few days.)

It could save a life.
